description: This Java class defines a MongoDB index abstraction, providing methods to create and manage index configurations, including options like uniqueness, sparsity, background creation, partial filter expressions, and expiration settings. The class includes functionality for converting index definitions to MongoDB driver models and for interpreting index information from MongoDB documents.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Immutable class representing a MongoDB index configuration, including keys, name, options, and optional expiration and partial filter expressions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Index instance with specified key document, name, and index options (unique, sparse, background).

methods.name: indexInfoOf
methods.description: Constructs an Index object from a MongoDB Document representing index metadata, parsing fields such as key, name, unique, sparse, background, expireAfterSeconds, and partialFilterExpression.

methods.name: withExpireAfterSeconds
methods.description: Returns a new Index object with the specified expiration time in seconds.

methods.name: withPartialFilterExpression
methods.description: Returns a new Index object with the specified partial filter expression.

methods.name: toIndexModel
methods.description: Converts this Index instance into a MongoDB IndexModel object suitable for creating indices via the driver.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the key document defining the index fields.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the index.

methods.name: isUnique
methods.description: Indicates whether the index enforces uniqueness.

methods.name: isSparse
methods.description: Indicates whether the index is sparse.

methods.name: isBackground
methods.description: Indicates whether the index is built in the background.

methods.name: getExpireAfterSeconds
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the expiration duration in seconds if set, otherwise empty.
